// ------------------------------------------------------------
// New Soldier groups:
// - InterpGroup_26 copies Soldier01 (original InterpGroup_0)
// - InterpGroup_27 copies Soldier02 (original InterpGroup_2)
// - SeqVar_Object_72/73 expose Unit6/Unit7
// - SeqVar_Named_54/55 resolve those names
//
// - Use new slot 6/7 positions and headings
// - Soldier07's sequence is delayed 2 seconds; Soldier08's later keys 4 seconds
// - Soldier08 keeps its negative-time opening idle and loops it to avoid a gap
// ------------------------------------------------------------
